definitions.gloss: to write in, to fill in
definitions.explanation: To write information into a form, document, or blank space.
To write a comment or message on a website, bulletin board, or social media.

notes:
{書|か}き{込|こ}む is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to write into something or post online.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into) → to write into

ASPECT (ている):
{書|か}き⟦{込|こ}んで→込む：00719_komu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing action of writing/posting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{込|こ}む (fill in a document)
- ⟦フォーム→フォーム：29244_foomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{込|こ}む (fill in a form)
- ⟦{掲示板|けいじばん}→掲示板：03052_keijiban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{込|こ}む (post on a bulletin board)
- ⟦SNS→SNS：05601_esuenuesu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{込|こ}む (post on social media)

RELATED NOUN:
- ⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}み→書き込み：09225_kakikomi⟧: a post, comment, entry (especially online)

MODERN USAGE:
In the internet age, {書|か}き{込|こ}む is commonly used for posting comments or messages online. ⟦{書|か}き{込|こ}み→書き込み：09225_kakikomi⟧ refers to such online posts or comments.
